proof_body:
by
  intro a p s h hp h0
  have key : ∀ K, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico (p k) (p (k + 1)), a i = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p K), a i := by
    intro K
    induction K with
    | zero => simp [h0]
    | succ K ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih, Finset.range_eq_Ico, Finset.range_eq_Ico]
      exact Finset.sum_Ico_consecutive _ (Nat.zero_le _) (hp (Nat.lt_succ_self K)).le
  simp only [key]
  exact h.comp hp.tendsto_atTop
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (p : ℕ → ℕ) (s : ℝ), Filter.Tendsto (fun m => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, a i) Filter.atTop (nhds s) → StrictMono p → p 0 = 0 → Filter.Tendsto (fun K => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico (p k) (p (k + 1)), a i) Filter.atTop (nhds s)
